messages:
maya (releases): Heads-up: nightly canary surfaced a regression where runtime 2.16.0 shows a memory growth on longseq for model slim-q. Proposing a scoped pin: route slim-q -> slim-q-legacy for canary-apac for next 4h while triage runs. :exclamation:

eli (runtime): I saw the leak during soak. Agree with model fallback; isolates risk quickly.

raja (ml): model perf is identical for short calls; longseq diff is only at token ~6k. fallback fine. Opening issue with traces.

toni (sdk): would prefer user-visible header when routing falls back. can deploybot annotate responses? Otherwise users with explicit model param unaffected.

sre-kim: need metrics guardrails: if mem_growth_rate > 2MB/s or 99p latency > 2x baseline in 30m, auto-unpin and alert. I'll wire alerts.

deploy-bot: Suggested command: `deploybot pin model slim-q --to slim-q-legacy --cohort canary-apac --region ap-southeast --duration 4h`

maya (releases): proposed window 23:00-03:00 UTC. schedule at 23:05, monitor 30m, then decide blended rollout.

eli (runtime): quick runbook snippet:
```
# pin for canary
deploybot pin model slim-q --to slim-q-legacy --cohort canary-apac --region ap-southeast --duration 4h
# rollback
deploybot unpin model slim-q --reason "auto-abort/mem-regress"
```

toni (sdk): ok. I'll add a release-notes blurb: "Temporary fallback for slim-q in APAC canary due to longseq memory growth."

raja (ml): running focused longseq repro now; will post heap profiles in 25m.

sre-kim: alerts set, pager if abort triggers.

maya (releases): prerun approvals: @eli, @toni, @sre-kim. pls ack with :thumbsup:.

eli (runtime): :thumbsup:

toni (sdk): :thumbsup:

sre-kim: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Action scheduled: pin 23:05 UTC (ap-southeast, canary-apac). Will post metric snapshot at 23:40 UTC.

maya (releases): thanks team  will update release-notes and escalate if rollback occurs.
